legacy_masks.reading: Each parent is named once with the highest coverage cutoff it clears. The list for any cutoff is the parents whose grade is at least that cutoff.
legacy_masks.completeness: Every parent strictly exceeding a listed coverage cutoff on the selected endpoint is retained. Standard summaries retain all pairs reaching at least 10% on either endpoint; their all-matching count also includes pairs below that listing floor.
legacy_masks.status: Superseded format; retained unchanged at original URLs

legacy_numeric_masks.rounding: Half-up from retained numeric summary values; inclusion decided before rounding
legacy_numeric_masks.reading: Each parent appears once as label@parent_percent|target_percent. Values have one decimal. Backslash escapes reserved label characters.
legacy_numeric_masks.completeness: Every pair already listed in the numeric summaries (at least 10% coverage on either side) is retained with both values; all target rows remain, including empty lists.
legacy_numeric_masks.status: Superseded format; retained unchanged at original URLs
